lastCompletedStory.title: Wire `cam issue demote <id>` CLI surface (parse + dispatch + help)

nextStoryContext: US-002 (CAM-206) wired `cam issue demote <id>` in index.ts as a 1:1 copy-paste of the CAM-210 close/abandon shape across the four documented sites: ParsedIssueArgs gained `{ mode: 'demote'; id: string; help: false }`; parseIssueArgs gained a `demote <id>` positional branch evaluated right after `abandon` and before the `--file-local` check (missing id -> parse error, extra positional -> parse error, same error-message phrasing as close/abandon); IssueDispatchDeps gained `demoteIssueOnMainFn?: (id: string) => DemoteIssueOnMainOutcome` (default `defaultDemoteIssueFn(process.cwd(), id)`, imported from ./src/release/post-merge.ts alongside defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn) and dispatchIssue gained a mode:'demote' branch identical in shape to close/abandon (printHint 'demoted <id> on main (<sha>)' + CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=<id> on ok:true, exit 0; printError + CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=ERROR reason=<reason> on !ok, exit 1 -- reason is one of already-idea/is-planned/is-shipped/not-found/diverged/detached-head/missing-main). ISSUE_HELP usage line and Arguments section now list `demote <id>` alongside close/abandon. Tests added in test/issue-dispatch.test.ts mirror the existing close/abandon describe blocks 1:1 (parse recognition, bare-positional non-text-mode, missing-id parse error, extra-arg parse error, free-text-starting-with-demote regression, routing isolation, id passthrough, success/already-idea/is-planned/not-found dispatch outcomes) plus a new regression-lock test proving the pre-existing CAM-211 central --help guard already short-circuits `cam issue demote --help` (via `main()`) with zero new guard code needed, since the guard matches on the top-level 'issue' command token and scans the whole tail for --help/-h. SPEC-vs-CONVENTION NOTE (carried from US-001's story notes, now resolved): the CAM-206 spec text originally wrote `cam issue --demote <id>` (flag form) but this story implements the positional `cam issue demote <id>` for 1:1 consistency with its close/abandon siblings, per patterns.md CAM-210 guidance; the functional WHAT (specified->idea, guards, handback) is unchanged either way. No further axis-mutation siblings are queued in this PRD as of this story.
